# 🧩 Vibe Patch
Yanosik tweaks and a few handy patches for other apps. The Yanosik patches get banner and voice ads out of the way, skip startup ads, hide PRO promos and let you use the local PRO settings. Pick the ones you want when patching.

Built on Morphe Patches. This is a custom collection, not an official Morphe release. The Yanosik patches currently support **26.9.0**.

To build it yourself, run `compile.bat` on Windows or `bash compile.sh` on Linux/macOS. You'll get `vibe-patch-<version>.mpp` in `patches/build/libs`. [Build and GitHub release setup](docs/build-and-release.md) covers the Java/SDK setup, credentials and automatic releases.

Import that bundle into Morphe Manager, choose your patches, then patch your original Yanosik APK and install the result. When you rebuild the bundle, you'll need to patch the APK again to get the changes on your phone.

## ❓ About

Morphe Patches are based off the prior work of [ReVanced](https://github.com/ReVanced).
All modifications made by Morphe, along with their dates, can be found in the Git history.

## 🩹 Patches list

Here's what each patch does. The descriptions below also show up in Morphe Manager, so you'll see the same wording when choosing patches. For the technical details and what's been tested, see the [Yanosik notes](docs/yanosik.md).

<!-- PATCHES_START -->
> **[v1.46.0](https://github.com/cfels/vibe-patches/releases/tag/v1.46.0)**&nbsp;&nbsp;•&nbsp;&nbsp;`main`&nbsp;&nbsp;•&nbsp;&nbsp;10 patches total
<details open>
<summary>📦 Yanosik&nbsp;&nbsp;•&nbsp;&nbsp;5 patches</summary>
<br>

**🎯 Supported versions:**

| 🧪&nbsp;26.9.0 |
| :---: |

| 💊&nbsp;Patch | 📜&nbsp;Description | ⚙️&nbsp;Options |
|----------|----------------|-----------|
| [Disable startup ad campaigns](#disable-startup-ad-campaigns) | Skips the ad campaigns shown when you open Yanosik, even ones already saved on your phone. Normal startup messages and account checks stay as they are. |  |
| [Disable voice ads](#disable-voice-ads) | Mutes the sponsored voice ads so they don't interrupt your drive. You still get navigation directions and road warnings, with the same audio controls. |  |
| [Hide banner ads](#hide-banner-ads) | Gets rid of banner ads on the map, during navigation and on the dashboard, including ad placeholders. Keeps road alerts and route controls in place. |  |
| [Override local PRO checks](#override-local-pro-checks) | Keeps local PRO mode on and opens up the PRO settings. Hides the Switch to PRO toggle. Purchases and server-side perks aren't changed. |  |
| [Suppress Premium promotions](#suppress-premium-promotions) | Hides PRO promo cards and upgrade shortcuts, including the sidebar card, and closes the PRO page. Donation and voucher pages stay available. |  |

</details>

<details open>
<summary>🌐 Universal&nbsp;&nbsp;•&nbsp;&nbsp;5 patches</summary>
<br>

| 💊&nbsp;Patch | 📜&nbsp;Description | ⚙️&nbsp;Options |
|----------|----------------|-----------|
| [Change installer source](#change-installer-source) | Makes the app think it was installed from the store you choose, like Google Play. | • App store to show |
| [Clone app](#clone-app) | Lets you install another copy of the app by giving it a different package name. Adds ".morphe" by default; each copy needs its own name. Some apps don't handle cloning well and may crash or behave strangely. | • Package name<br>• Update permissions<br>• Update providers |
| [Disable Play Store updates](#disable-play-store-updates) | Stops Play Store updates by setting the app's version code to the highest Android allows. Can cause issues in some apps and won't work with root-mounted installs. |  |
| [Override certificate pinning](#override-certificate-pinning) | Lets you inspect the app's network traffic through a proxy by bypassing certificate pinning. |  |
| [Spoof signature](#spoof-signature) | Makes the app see the original APK's signature when it checks its own package. |  |

</details>

## Contributing

If you're changing a Yanosik patch, start with the [Yanosik notes](docs/yanosik.md). They explain what each patch changes and which checks to run.

For patches aimed at other apps, you can start your own collection with the [Patches template](https://github.com/morpheapp/morphe-patches-template).
